page.overview:
Who is King Vegeta's Majordomo?

King Vegeta's Majordomo is a Saiyan who serves the Saiyan Royal Family.

He is a slender, medium-sized Saiyan with pale skin and a large black mustache which is cut flush like his hair. He wears black and white combat armor, whose lower part extends almost to the height of his heels as if it were a tunic, and under it he wears an elastic suit of dark blue spandex, as well as white gloves and white boots with a yellow tip outlined.

He is a dutiful and loyal servant to the House of Vegeta. Due to the nature of his occupation, he speaks in a respectable and polite manner. However, he sometimes states the glaringly obvious such as when he informed King Vegeta of the Great King Cold's arrival when it was obvious given the large number of Cold Force members that accompanied King Cold's Spaceship as it made landfall.

King Vegeta's Majordomo can be seen in the palace informing King Vegeta that the Great King Cold has arrived only for King Vegeta to angrily retorts he knows that already as the castle shacks from a Cold Force spacecraft hitting a nearby building and King Cold's Spaceship flying past the window as it prepares to land.
